items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) New CEO Greg Abel Wins Charlie Munger Backing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.B) vice chair Charlie Munger has publicly backed Greg Abel as the conglomerate's new chief executive. Munger described Abel as a "tremendous learning machine" and compared his abilities to those of Warren Buffett in recent remarks. He highlighted Abel's long involvement with Berkshire's non-insurance operations as preparation for leading the group-wide portfolio.
